mailwoman:sources.citation: Abai, Zhetisu and Ulytau Regions were formed on 8 June 2022 from East Kazakhstan, Almaty and Karaganda Regions. Shymkent became a city of republican significance in June 2018, outside the region then renamed Turkistan. ISO 3166-2:KZ lists all four.

The union of the Who's On First county records Koksuskiy (1108785405), Aksuskiy (1108785407), Panfilovskiy (1108785409), Alakolskiy (1108785413), Karatal`skiy (1108785415), Sarkandskiy (1108785417), Kerbulakskiy (1108785423), Taldyqorghan (1108785635). Each member is assigned to the region its Wikidata item is located in (P131), read on 2026-11-26. A member without a Wikidata item is assigned to the region that GeoNames files most of the populated places inside its boundary under.
